construct_bond_matrix: construct a bond adjacency matrix for a pymatgen crystal structure using a NearNeighbors finder
construct_bond_matrix_with_permutations: construct a bond matrix with custom site permutations for reordered atom indices in a crystal structure
review_construct_bond_matrix: review the construct_bond_matrix function to verify it correctly builds an adjacency matrix from near-neighbor info
test_construct_bond_matrix: test the construct_bond_matrix function with a pymatgen Structure and NearNeighbors instance to validate bond detection
refactor_construct_bond_matrix: refactor construct_bond_matrix to support additional near-neighbor algorithms beyond the default pymatgen NearNeighbors
